One precision on the consumer: the call right after, 0x1416a3aff, is Vm_Holder_SetCStr(holder [rsp+0x48], [rdi+0xb0]), a separate field of the team record that does not touch the key. The key itself goes to 0x1416864d0(rcx = [rsp+0x50], rdx = rsp+0x60) at 0x1416a3b0e, the same registry-path bind as the other two sites, and is then released (0x1416a3b13-).
